homelink_farm.configuration.title: HomeLink Farm configuration
Zone limits and scan budget of Crop Monitors.
homelink_farm.configuration.maxLinkDista: Maximum distance, in blocks, between a Farm Controller and a linked device.
homelink_farm.configuration.maxComponent: Maximum number of Crop Monitors and Pumps linked to one Farm Controller.
homelink_farm.configuration.maxCropMonit: Maximum number of blocks (X × Y × Z) in one Crop Monitor zone.
homelink_farm.configuration.maxZoneDista: Maximum distance between a Crop Monitor and any block of its zone.
homelink_farm.configuration.cropScanInte: Ticks between two scans of a zone (20 ticks = 1 second).
homelink_farm.configuration.cropScanBudg: Zone positions one Crop Monitor examines per tick.
homelink_farm.configuration.globalScanBu: Zone positions examined per tick by all Crop Monitors together.
homelink_farm.configuration.locateDurati: How long (ticks) a LOCATE marker stays visible.
homelink_farm.configuration.maxSprinkler: Sprinklers one pump can feed (official rule: 5). Above that the whole network is over capacity.
homelink_farm.configuration.maxNetworkNo: Maximum pipes, pumps and sprinklers in one network.
homelink_farm.configuration.sprinklerRan: Horizontal reach: a sprinkler covers a (2 × range + 1) square. 2 = 5 × 5.
homelink_farm.configuration.irrigationGr: Growth speed bonus of irrigated crops (0.20 = +20%). Never stacks.
